liberty.reason: The macro's Liberty limits the transition at its address, data-in and write-mask inputs to 0.04 ns, the last index of its characterisation table. No sky130_fd_sc_hd cell can drive that (OpenROAD: best achievable 0.069 ns at 0.01 pF), and LibreLane's post-global-routing design repair stops with RSZ-0090. Both flows and the timing gate read a copy without these three attributes; the library's default_max_transition of 0.5 ns then applies to those pins.
